sourceTitle: Chocolate Cinnamon Biscuit Spirals with Xocai Healthy Chocolate
sourceText:
Chocolate Cinnamon Biscuit Spirals with Xocai Healthy Chocolate
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Wednesday, October 12, 2011 - 6:10am

Ingredients




2 cup 	flour
1 tbsp 	baking powder
1/2 cup 	butter or margarine, softened, divided
1/2 tsp 	salt
4 tbsp 	sugar
1 whole 	eggs
1/2 cup 	milk
2 tsp 	vanilla
1/2 tsp 	cinnamon
3 tbsp 	brown sugar
3 tbsp 	chopped walnuts
2 chunk 	Xocai X Power Squares

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 400 degrees and grease 9-inch baking pan. Mix flour, baking powder, 1/4 cup of butter, salt, and sugar until it forms course crumbs. Add egg, milk and vanilla. Roll with rolling pin on flat surface to 1/4 inch thick. Cover with remaining butter, cinnamon, brown sugar, walnuts, and chopped X Power Squares. Roll the dough into a log and slice into 1/2-inch pieces. Bake until golden brown.

About

Cinnamon Biscuit Spirals combined with "Xocai Healthy Chocolate" make for a sweet treat!
